entries.title: Psalms 7:1
segments: <<Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehova, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite.>> O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,

entries.title: Psalms 7:2
segments: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

entries.title: Psalms 7:3
segments: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;

entries.title: Psalms 7:4
segments: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary;)

entries.title: Psalms 7:5
segments: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 7:6
segments: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 7:7
segments: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.

entries.title: Psalms 7:8
segments: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.

entries.title: Psalms 7:9
segments: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 7:10
segments: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 7:11
segments: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.

entries.title: Psalms 7:12
segments: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

entries.title: Psalms 7:13
segments: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery [shafts].

entries.title: Psalms 7:14
segments: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 7:15
segments: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

entries.title: Psalms 7:16
segments: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

entries.title: Psalms 7:17
segments: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.
